newsitem.title: UK: Vickers sales of Rolls, Bentley up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Vickers sales of Rolls, Bentley up in 1996.

text.p: Vickers Plc said on Wednesday that worldwide and sales of Rolls-Royce and Bentley cars were up 12 percent in 1996 from the previous year.
It said in a statement that retail sales rose to 1,744 in 1996 compared with 1,556 in 1995.
Vickers said the introduction of the Rolls-Royce Silver Dawn, and the uprated Bentley Brooklands, accounted for nearly all of the growth.
The auto and defence manufacturer said retail sales in the UK showed the biggest increase and that there was encouraging growth in the Middle East & Africa and Japan.
"Only Continental Europe, which had been the slowest of the company's export markets all year, finished with sales down," said Vickers.
